description_en: Queries traffic statistics of an Anti-DDoS Origin instance within a specific time period
description_zh: 查询指定时间段内某个DDoS原生防护实例的流量统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp describe-traffic --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w203qg0000 --ipnet 111.XX.XX.0/24 --ip 39.XX.XX.96 --start-time 1619798400 --end-time 1563445054 --interval 5 --flow-type max --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeTraffic

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~) operation to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances.

If you specify an on-demand instance, you must configure the **Interval** parameter.
parameters.description_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~)查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID。


如果此处设置的实例用于代播防护，您必须设置请求参数**Interval**。

parameters.description_en: The Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block of the on-demand instance that you want to query.

parameters.name: ipnet

parameters.description_en:
The public IP address of the asset to query. If you do not specify this parameter, the traffic statistics of all public IP addresses that are protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance are queried.

>  The public IP address must be a protected object of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. You can call the [DescribePackIpList](~~118701~~) operation to query all protected objects of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.
parameters.description_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产。不设置该参数表示查询DDoS原生防护实例防护的所有公网IP资产的流量统计数据。

> 公网IP资产必须已经添加为DDoS原生防护实例的防护对象。您可以调用[DescribePackIpList](~~118701~~)查询DDoS原生防护实例的所有防护对象。

parameters.description_en: The interval at which the traffic statistics are calculated. Unit: seconds. Default value: **5**.
parameters.description_zh: 设置流量统计的时间间隔，单位：秒，表示将每多少秒时间段作为一个区间，统计该区间内的流量数据。默认值为**5**。

parameters.name: interval

parameters.description_en:
The type of the traffic statistics to query. Valid values:

*   **max**: the peak traffic within the specified interval.
*   **avg**: the average traffic within the specified interval.

Enumerated values:

*   all
*   avg
*   max
parameters.description_zh:
要查询的流量统计数据的类型。取值：

- **max**：表示统计时间区间内的流量峰值。
- **avg**：表示统计时间区间内的流量均值。
